method: radimagenet-mlx ResNet50 pooled and spatial features for every axial slice of one LUNA16 CT, extracted with the published runner

citations: Setio et al., Medical Image Analysis 42 (2017) 1-13
Armato et al., Medical Physics 38(2) (2011) 915-931 (LIDC-IDRI, TCIA)
source.derivation: Local read-only copy: LUNA16 MetaImage converted to HU NIfTI. Not copied into this repository.

inference.input: one 8-bit grayscale PNG per axial slice, superior to inferior: window 40/400 HU, square body crop (rows, cols, side) [38, 30, 453] px; the runner resizes it to 224 x 224 itself

display.slices_shown: 150 of 152, superior to inferior; the 2 most superior slices (shoulder joints) are not shown, and principal components and feature statistics use the shown slices only
display.ct_panel: the PNG passed to the runner, Lanczos-resized to 448 px, with the 7 x 7 conv5_block3_out map drawn as cells screen-blended at 0.62 inside the body, with darkened cell borders
display.cell_colors: first three principal components of all 7350 spatial vectors in the scan as RGB, each scaled by its 2nd-98th percentile
display.feature_panel: 96 of 2048 pooled features with the largest variance across slices, z-scored per feature over the scan and clipped to [-0.5, 3.0], rows ordered by the slice where each feature peaks; one column per slice
display.font: Inter SemiBold 40 px, Inter Regular 30 px (SIL Open Font License)

animation.dissolve: smoothstep cross-dissolve of rendered RGB frames from the last slice back to the first; the outgoing slice label fades out over the first half and the incoming label fades in over the second

interpretation: Image features from one public, de-identified CT for a software visualization. The features carry no diagnostic labels.
